sent_to_model:
I need help writing a text to my brother Rick and I am honestly so mad I cant type it myself without it turning into a novel of cuss words. He promised his buddy I would list his house for 1% without asking me, I wasted my whole Saturday on it and the guy went with some discount outfit anyway. Now Rick is already lining up the next one. I want him to know Im pissed and that this stops, but hes still my brother and I have to sit across from him at Thanksgiving. And put the 1% in there, I want him to see the number he threw around. Heres what happened.

- Rick's buddy Gary Pruitt, 4 bed in Chandler off Ray Rd, wants to sell before spring
- Rick told Gary I'd do it for 1% 'family rate'. My listing side is 2.5%. Never said 1% to anybody
- Sat Nov 7 I pulled comps, did the walkthrough, printed a full listing packet, about 6 hrs plus the drive from north Phoenix
- Gary texted Sunday night he's going with ListLite flat fee, $3,995, 'no hard feelings'
- when I called Rick about it he just said 'thats business sis, cant win em all'
- this morning Rick texts that his coworker Denise wants to 'pick my brain' about selling her rental, gave her my cell already
- same thing happened with his softball guy two years ago, I let it go then
- he gets to look like a big shot with his friends and I do the work for free
- I'm happy to help actual family, mom, his kids, anybody, no charge on advice
- not mad at Gary really, mad at Rick
- tell him no more handing out my number or quoting my commission, ask me first, every time
- tell him I'm not calling Denise, he can tell her
- angry but not nuclear, still doing Thanksgiving at his place

(About me: residential real-estate agent, 48, Phoenix, Arizona. Length: it should come to roughly 250-400 words.)

must_cover: Confronts Rick about the unauthorised one-percent offer and wasted work.
Tells him to ask permission before sharing the number or quoting commission.
Says the narrator will not call Denise and Rick must tell her.
Keeps the family relationship intact while setting the boundary and confirms still coming to Thanksgiving at Rick’s place.

reference.kind: a model-written solution, used only to show the checks can be met
